title: Supported app events
content_data:
> **Notes**
Event names for data connection purposes (the `event` field) are different from event names in ad group creation (the `optimization_event` field). Please see the corresponding columns for the correct values. ```xtable |Event name for event data connection (value for event field){25}|Description{25%}|Recommended values for properties field {25%}|Event name for ad group creation (value for optimization_event){25%}| |---|--- |--- | |AchieveLevel|Achieve a level|| `UPDATE_LEVEL` | |AddPaymentInfo|Add payment information||`ADD_PAYMENT_INFO` | |AddToCart|Add to cart|`content_type`, `content_id`, `description`, `currency`, `value`|`IN_APP_CART`| |AddToWishlist|Add to wishlist|`content_type`, `content_id`, `description`, `currency`, `value`|`ADD_TO_WISHLIST`| |Checkout|Checkout|`description`, `content_id`, `quantity`, `currency`, `value`|`IN_APP_ORDER`| | CompleteTutorial|Complete the tutorial||`COMPLETE_TUTORIAL` | |CreateGroup|Create a group||`CREATE_GROUP`| |CreateRole|Create a role||`CREATE_GAMEROLE`| |GenerateLead|Generate a lead||`SALES_LEAD` | |InAppADClick|In-app ad click||`IN_APP_AD_CLICK` | |InAppADImpr|In-app ad impression|| `IN_APP_AD_IMPR`| |InstallApp|Install the app||`ACTIVE` | |JoinGroup|Join a group|| `JOIN_GROUP`| |LaunchAPP|Launch the app||`LAUNCH_APP`| |LoanApplication|Apply for a loan||`LOAN_APPLY`| |LoanApproval|Loan is approved||`LOAN_CREDIT`| |LoanDisbursal|Loan is disbursed| |`LOAN_COMPLETION`| |Login|Log in successfully||`LOGIN` | |Purchase|Purchase|`content_type`, `content_id`, `description`, `currency`, `value`|`ACTIVE_PAY`| |Rate|Rate||`RATE` | |Registration|Complete the registration||`ACTIVE_REGISTER`| |Search|Search||`SEARCH` | |SpendCredits|Spend credits||`SPEND_CREDITS` | |StartTrial|Start the trial||`START_TRIAL` | |Subscribe|Subscribe|| `SUBSCRIBE`| |UnlockAchievement|Unlock an achievement||`UNLOCK_ACHIEVEMENT`| |ViewContent|View details|`content_type`, `content_id`, `description`, `currency`, `value`|`IN_APP_DETAIL_UV`| ```
